releases.name: Trust and recovery beta
releases.testingGoal: Let testers exercise Ishiki's highest-risk privacy, account, recovery, and release-safety paths before broader feature testing.
releases.releaseGate: All assigned privacy and recovery acceptance checks pass on disposable data, the iPhone Expo handoff check passes before tester sessions, and no critical or high-priority blocker is open.
releases.feedbackFocus: Unexpected access, destructive outcomes, unclear recovery advice, and release checks that cannot be trusted.
knownExclusions: Everyday health, money, and connected-life feature breadth belongs to later release testing.
Production publishing, deployment, and real credential changes are not part of this test cycle.

releases.name: Everyday health and money beta
releases.testingGoal: Give testers coherent health, medication, money, work, and daily-planning workflows after the trust baseline is stable.
releases.releaseGate: R1 feedback is triaged; core health and money browser/mobile acceptance passes; no unresolved data-integrity blocker remains.
releases.feedbackFocus: Whether daily records are easy to create, correct, understand, and recover across desktop and mobile.
knownExclusions: Calendar, household, recipe, study, and broader connected-life testing belongs to R3.
Unfinished native integrations and production publishing are not part of this test cycle.

releases.name: Connected life beta
releases.testingGoal: Expand testing to Calendar, feedback, household coordination, imports, recipes, study, and other connected workflows.
releases.releaseGate: Earlier release feedback is resolved or explicitly deferred; connection and sharing boundaries pass privacy review.
releases.feedbackFocus: Consent, sharing boundaries, reconnection, cross-device continuity, and whether connected workflows reduce manual effort.
knownExclusions: Any connected workflow that has not passed its privacy and consent checks remains excluded.
Production publishing and unsupported provider integrations are not part of this test cycle.
